purpose: Close the bounded Adam7 interlace decoder gap for 8-bit RGBA PNG sidecar carriers without claiming APNG or full PNG conformance.

external_anchors.used_for: IHDR interlace method values, Adam7 pass extraction order, filter method 0, IDAT zlib stream, and PNG chunk validation.

limitations: Stage 0 Adam7 decoder supports 8-bit RGBA PNG only.
APNG, 16-bit channels, grayscale-alpha, and full PNG conformance are not claimed.
